finmodel.label: 03 — Financial Engineering
finmodel.sub: A 3-statement-style model built in Excel — the same discipline I bring to every client engagement, and the foundation for my upcoming Master's in Financial Engineering.
finmodel.p1: Every output is driven by a single, clearly documented Hypotheses tab: revenue growth, COGS as % of revenue, SG&A as % of revenue, depreciation, interest on credit lines and borrowings, the effective tax rate, minority interests, and working-capital days (receivables, inventory, payables).
finmodel.p2: The model computes operating income, net income and forward projections — the numbers a lender, investor or budget owner actually makes decisions with.
finmodel.f1d: Full P&L from revenue to net income, with minority interests and equity-method income.
finmodel.f2d: Growth, margins, tax, working capital and financing drivers — all configurable in one tab.
finmodel.f3d: Forward projections with period-over-period evolution of every line item.
finmodel.plain: In plain terms: this tool projects a company's revenue, costs and profitability several years ahead, starting from a handful of adjustable business assumptions — how fast sales grow, what costs eat into them, how the company is financed and taxed. It's the kind of model used for budgeting, fundraising and investment decisions.
finmodel.plain2: Change one assumption — say, growth from 5% to 8% — and the entire forecast recalculates instantly.
finmodel.chartCaption: Model output — revenue and net income trajectory at the model's own 5% growth assumption
finmodel.capAssumptions: The Hypothèses tab — one place to steer the whole model
finmodel.capPnl: Income statement — from revenue to net income
finmodel.capForecast: Forecast — projected statements, period by period

about.label: 06 — About
about.p1: I am Elom Samuel Toublou, a data analyst and economist based in Lomé, Togo. I hold a Licence (BA) in International Economics from the Université de Lomé (GPA 13.28/20, ranked 11th of 61) and I have chosen a simple specialty: building analytical tools that work in production, not slide-deck toys.
about.p2: I have delivered multi-user Excel/VBA platforms to local businesses, cleaned and analyzed 10,000+-row databases for SMEs, and automated reporting pipelines that cut processing time by up to 80%.
about.p3: I train, too. Two distinct engagements, each honest in its scale:
about.train1d: Certified trainer for the Francophonie's D-CLIC program (Data Analyst & Data Protection track), delivered with Cube SAEI across Togo. Attestation of successful completion issued by the OIF, April 2026.
about.train2t: ISM B Group & Cube SAEI — Big Data & Data Protection
about.train2d: Specialized training delivered to students in that track — a targeted, high-touch corporate teaching engagement, from course design through to their state-recognized certification.
about.goal: My goal: become a world-class specialist in advanced economic and financial data analysis, at the intersection of AI, quantitative finance and global policy.
